Dataset & Population: NHANES 2011-2014, adult participants aged 18+ years; 9,308 participants.
Method: CHAP wrist model with CRIB sleep classification.
Estimate & Notes: Waking sedentary time: 9.8 hours/day; 61.3% of waking time. Mean waking time was 16.0 hours/day.

Dataset & Population: NHANES 2003-2004; hip-worn ActiGraph data; 6,329 participants, aged 6+ years.
Estimate & Notes: Sedentary time: 7.7 hours/day; 54.9% of monitored time. Mean monitor wear time was 13.9 hours/day.

Method: Self-reported total sitting time from questionnaire.
Estimate & Notes: Sedentary time: 6.4 hours/day in adults; 8.2 hours/day in adolescents. Sitting time increased in both groups from 2001 onward.

Method: Self-reported sitting time on a typical day.
Estimate & Notes: Approximately 6.4 hours/day; 25.7% of adults reported sitting for more than 8 hours per day.
